summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VIII filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing that holders of its units may begin separately trading the Class A ordinary shares and warrants included in those units on or about October 5, 2026. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one-third of one redeemable warrant. Unseparated units continue trading on Nasdaq as IPHXU, while shares and warrants trade as IPHX and IPHXW. No fractional warrants will be issued. This is a routine SPAC unit-separation notice, not a special situation, with no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor stated.
